name: US open-front picking bin 10.875 x 5.5 x 5 in
description:
A US open-front picking bin, 10.875 x 5.5 x 5 in depth x width x height (276 x 140 x 127 mm), modelled on the Akro-Mils AkroBin 30230 from Akro-Mils sheet AKM505. The AkroBin part-number ladder is the de facto US reference for this family, and Quantum QUS and Uline sizes match it. The front wall stands at roughly 40% of the back wall's height with the side walls sweeping down between them on a curve, so an operator can reach in and pick without lifting the bin off the shelf.

External dimensions: depth 276 mm, width 140 mm, height 127 mm.

No formal standard; the Akro-Mils AkroBin part-number ladder is the de facto US reference, matched by Quantum QUS and Uline.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 1,188 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
